objective: Discover a computable path score that separates visually obvious, model-relative bad cases from ordinary model-quality outputs before the endpoint is complete.

quality_endpoint.negative_semantics_warning: The negative label means no clear overall bad case was established; it is not equivalent to a separately adjudicated pristine-good label.
bad_case_scope: obvious global or major-region blur below the same-model cohort
conspicuous fusion or duplicated major structure
major limb, body-part, or object misalignment

legacy_64_path_pool.reason: Labels and the original likelihood-ratio summaries have already been unsealed; this pool cannot validate a newly selected metric.

new_discovery.expansion_rule: Expand only because the locked visual labels contain too few clear bad events; do not inspect candidate scores when deciding to expand.

new_confirmation.unseal_rule: Freeze one primary score, at most two single-feature backups, all reference normalization, thresholds, and code hashes before joining confirmation labels to metrics.

sampling_phase_axis.array_order: sampling step k=0..249, corresponding to internal timestep t=249..0

candidate_families: predictable predicted-clean latent amplitude and spatial roughness
online-causal realized Gaussian innovation surprise and localization
predictable cross-scale score disagreement and spatial concentration
online-causal directional innovation and likelihood-ratio shape
retrospective endpoint blur, edge, spectrum, and semantic negative controls

legacy_emerging_hypothesis.name: two_phase_predicted_clean_instability
components: q1 per-channel amplitude-normalized predicted-clean Dirichlet roughness
q2 predicted-clean per-channel log spatial variance
legacy_emerging_hypothesis.interpretation: A possible early rough/unstable phase followed by a mid-trajectory amplitude overshoot. It is not a posterior probability and is not yet a detector.

time_availability.predictable: Uses only the current state and model outputs available before the current Gaussian innovation is drawn.
time_availability.online_causal: Uses the just-observed transition or the change from the previous prediction and can affect only later steps or a rollback.
time_availability.retrospective: Uses a future state, endpoint, whole-path maximum, or endpoint image and is eligible only for mining or mechanism discovery.

combination_search.outer_validation: grouped by class or semantic superclass, with a separate seed/prefix grouped audit
combination_search.inner_model: elastic-net logistic regression or a low-degree predeclared interaction model
combination_search.primary_selection_target: partial ROC area at false-positive rate <= 0.10
combination_search.maximum_frozen_outputs: one primary combination and two single-feature backups

claims_forbidden_on_legacy_data: authorization to guide, reject, resample, or roll back
